Based on my search, here's how to actually pronounce "doge":

## The Correct Pronunciation

The correct pronunciation of "doge" is **"dohj"** — rhyming with "rogue" or "vogue" but with a soft 'j' sound at the end. In IPA (International Phonetic Alphabet), this is written as **/dəʊʒ/** (British) or **/doʊʒ/** (American).

## Breaking It Down

- **"do"** — pronounced like the "do" in "don't" or "dough"
- **"ge"** — pronounced like the "j" in French "je" or the "s" in "vision" (the soft 'zh' sound)

It's **one syllable**, not two. It does NOT rhyme with "dog" or "dodge."

## The Origin

This pronunciation was confirmed by Dogecoin co-creator Jackson Palmer. The word originated from the Homestar Runner animated web series (2005), where a character spells out "D-O-G-E" and it's pronounced "dohj." It was a deliberate misspelling of "dog" for comedic effect.

## Common Mispronunciations to Avoid

| Incorrect | Why It's Wrong |
|-----------|--------------|
| "dog" or "doggy" | Treats it like a regular English word |
| "dodge" | Adds an extra syllable and wrong vowel sound |
| "dog-ee" | Makes it two syllables incorrectly |
| "dogue" (rhyming with vogue) | Close, but misses the soft 'zh' ending |

## A Note on the Historical Title

Interestingly, "doge" is also the title for the chief magistrate of the former republics of Venice and Genoa. This historical Italian word is pronounced similarly — **/ˈdoʊdʒ/** or **/dəʊdʒ/** in English, though in Italian it's closer to **/ˈdoːdʒe/**. However, for the internet meme and cryptocurrency, stick with "dohj" (/doʊʒ/).
